How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    This is the third time I've purchased this shirt...this time in Beige. The first two I ordered were white and black. I ordered size medium in all three and the size has been consistent every time. The shirt is definitely fitted so if you're on the border of one or another size, I would suggest size up, but it may vary depending on body size and how you like your shirts to fit. It isn't a cropped shirt, however, it is on the shorter side with not a lot of material to tuck in, if that's your thing. The material is ribbed and soft. The lighter colors aren't super see-through, although you can see your bra lines. I always wash on cold and line dry to avoid shrinking and they turned out fine. Overall, it's a really cute shirt that is a step above a regular tee because of the style, ribbed material and little buttons, which add to the style, and they even work. Very happy with these slim fit tees!
